start: Owner on the Visits page; the register has been used for some weeks and a few paying members stopped coming

steps.action: Tap the tab "Losing the habit"
user_sees: Line "Paying members who are losing the habit"
Tile "Need a word" with "of {n} listed"
One tile per group, with its line: "New, and not coming regularly yet", "Away longer than they usually are", "Weeks without a visit"
Card "Who to talk to" with the advice that starts "Everyone here has weeks left on their plan, but they stopped coming or never really started."
must_not: A member whose plan has ended on the list
A member who came today on the list
The count on the tab differing from "of {n} listed"

steps.action: Tap a group chip under "Filter by what is happening"
user_sees: Only members of that group; "Need a word" shows that number
Each card: name, the reason in words, the group pill, "Usually 6–7 am" when known, "Last visit …"
must_not: Members of other groups left in the list
A reason that contradicts the last visit shown

steps.action: Tap "Message" on a member
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on a chat with that member's number, with an empty message box
must_not: The panel sends a message by itself
The chat opens on another member's number
A number without its country code, so the chat does not open

steps.action: Tap the member's name
user_sees: That member's page
must_not: Another member's page

start: Owner on Visits → "Losing the habit" with members listed

steps.action: Pick a group chip, then tap "Download Excel file"
user_sees: A file named after the gym, "at-risk" and today's date downloads
A toast "Exported {n} members." (or "Exported 1 member.")
Columns: Member, Mobile, Batch, Status, Last visit, Days since visit, Visits in last 8 weeks, Why
must_not: The file holds everyone when a group was picked
Mobile numbers turned into 9.87E+11 by the spreadsheet
A member who never came shown with an empty last visit instead of "Never"

steps.action: Open the /attendance/risk address directly (the other way in)
user_sees: The same list with the "Losing the habit" tab picked
must_not: The Register tab opens instead

steps.action: Open the tab in a gym that has not used the register yet
user_sees: "Start checking members in"
"This list needs a few days of check-ins first. Check members in as they arrive, and it fills in by itself. Nobody is listed just because their visits were never added."
Button "Open the register"
must_not: Every paying member listed as gone because no visits were ever added

steps.action: Open the tab in a gym where everyone comes as usual
user_sees: "Everybody is training" / "Every member with a running plan is coming as usual."
Button "Back to the register"
must_not: An empty card with no words

steps.action: With members listed, tap a group chip that has a count of 0
user_sees: "Nobody in this group"
"Download Excel file" is greyed
must_not: An empty file downloads

start: Owner on Visits → "Losing the habit"; a listed member walks in

steps.action: Note the count on the tab, go to "Register" and check the member in
user_sees: Toast "<name> checked in."
The count on "Losing the habit" changes if the visit takes them off the list
must_not: The member stays on the list with "Last visit" still showing the old day

steps.action: Open "Losing the habit"
user_sees: The member is gone from the list or shows "Last visit today"
must_not: The tab count and the list disagree

steps.action: Go back to "Register" and tap "Undo" on that check-in, then open "Losing the habit"
user_sees: The member is back as before
must_not: The member lost from both lists

steps.action: Tap "Download Excel file"
user_sees: A file with each listed member's name and mobile number leaves the panel onto this device
must_not: Members of another gym or branch in the file
More personal data in the file than the eight columns named on screen

steps.action: Tap "Message" on a member
user_sees: A WhatsApp chat on this device's own WhatsApp; the member's number goes to WhatsApp only when the button is tapped
must_not: A message sent without a person typing and sending it
